# Francesco Belacca

## About

Francesco Belacca is a Senior Site Reliability Engineer based in Parma, Italy. His work focuses on Azure, cloud platforms, DevOps, governance, automation, observability, and making complex systems reliable and understandable.

## Selected work

- [Belacca Platform](https://github.com/macel94/belacca-platform): A GitOps workspace orchestrating the public platform across application repositories, Kubernetes manifests, and Flux-driven delivery.
- [Cloud Native Pong](https://pong.belacca.com/): A multiplayer game where each room runs as its own Kubernetes pod, using Go and WebSockets.
- [EU Azure Foundry Scout](https://github.com/macel94/eu-azfoundry-scout): An automated DevOps utility that maps Azure AI Foundry model availability and EU data-residency support.
- [Post-Quantum .NET](https://github.com/macel94/postquantumdotnettest): Benchmarks comparing classical ECDH with ML-KEM post-quantum cryptography, including TLS 1.3 handshakes.
- [AKS 3-Tier Platform](https://github.com/macel94/AKS-3-Tier-App): A cloud-native reference architecture exploring delivery, resilience, and observability on Azure Kubernetes Service.
- [Technical Sessions](https://github.com/macel94/Technical-Sessions): Talks, demos, and practical engineering notes.
